newsitem.title: CANADA: DBRS confirms, Manitoba, Alberta Pool.
newsitem.headline: DBRS confirms, Manitoba, Alberta Pool.

text.p: Dominion Bond Rating Service Ltd on Tuesday confirmed the debt ratings of three of Canada's top six grain handlers.

DBRS confirmed Winnipeg based United Grain Growers Ltd at BB (high) and R-2 (low) after a hostile C$172 million takeover bid for UGG was dropped last Tuesday by rival firms Alberta Wheat Pool and Manitoba Pool Elevators, a DBRS statement said.
The debt rating agency put all three firms on a credit watch February 20 after AWP and MPE announced their takeover bid at C$13.75 for all outstanding limited common voting shares of UGG.

"(UGG) earnings are expected to be affected by one-time costs associated with defending the offer but these costs are not expected to be material to ratings. Consolidation is still anticipated for the Canadian grain industry since continued deregulation is expected to further increase competition," DBRS' statement said.
AWP's rating was confirmed at BBB (low) and R-2 (middle).
DBRS confirmed MPE's debt rating at BB (high) and R-2 (low).
